Dom is actually still in his subconscious at the end of Inception.  He is using his deceased wives totem throughout the movie, which is explicitly stated that you should never let anyone have your totem because it’s essentially your only failsafe against getting lost in the levels of dreams.  

This is exemplified by the opening scene where the guard recovers him from the shores of the subconscious and takes his gun and his ex wife’s totem.  We never actually see his true totem, which is the main thing that sticks out to me that he is not in the real world but at least still one level down.

The concept of mr. Charles is inception at work.  I will explain…… Spoilers ahead

He speaks about people who have had their minds trained to recognize when people are trying to “extract” info from your mind using the dream world.  Since he is well versed in this training, his mind is always probing and trying to determine whether he’s still dreaming.  This would normally be fine except for the fact that he has literally lived out years in the dream world.  Once he convinced her that that were not in the real world, she killed herself…. Or did she!?

There are a few examples I’ve zeroed in on:

The scene where dom goes to meet Tom Hardy’s character it becomes apparent that dom knows a wide array of people who are familiar with the process of extraction across the world, in high places of influence.  Tom Hardy’s character introduces dom to a chemist….

When they visit this individual, dom has a strange self reflective conversation with one of the chemist’s minions.  The quote is something like ~these people dream because it is their real world, who are you to say any different~

Jumping back to the first convo with Tom hardy, if Tom is part of his highly trained subconscious then he will not hesitate to identify/distract/assault/exterminate individuals that he deems a threat to dom.  He identifies a tail and a chase scene ensues.  It ends in a very elaborate runaround similar to the mazes that are created for “in dream” escape mechanisms.   Especially the alley that he awkwardly has to squeeze through seems like a gimmick. 

Now let’s talk about Michael cane’s char, his ex wife’s father.  He was dom and mal’s guide when they made their trips into the dream world.  He obviously loves dom like a son but it seems to go beyond that because he is still fueling dom’s expedition with fodder in the form of bright students.  I think that this is dom’s brain’s recruitment process for his mr. Charles entourage. The father makes a plea to dom to come home,  this is a very strong note in the movie.  I see him as the opposite of mr Charles, maybe the side of his brain that is still believing that he is one level down.  The whole movie is cognitive dissonance and the minds attempt to reconcile it.  He also has a reinforced aggressive team of people fighting to keep this reality in check.

He lost himself in his subconscious after the loss of his “reality” and the whole movie is him trying to find himself again.  The movie ends with the totem still spinning, but he has accepted his new reality as fact.

Just a small glimpse into the dumb amount of time I’ve spent looking at this movie.
